properties.description:
Located in the heart of Nottingham, the Motorpoint Arena is one of the UK?s premier indoor entertainment venues. Opened in 2000, the arena has a capacity of up to 10,000 and regularly hosts world-class concerts, sporting events, comedy shows, exhibitions, and family performances. As part of the National Ice Centre complex, it also serves as a key hub for ice sports, including figure skating and ice hockey.
With its striking modern facade and central location, the Motorpoint Arena is a landmark destination that attracts hundreds of thousands of visitors each year. It features state-of-the-art facilities, multiple hospitality suites, and convenient access to public transport, making it a cornerstone of Nottingham's cultural and entertainment scene.
properties.title: Motorpoint Arena
